summary.title: Different offices answer different civic questions
summary.mayorText: The City Mayor is Makati’s chief executive and leads the city administration, development planning and implementation of city programs under the charter.
summary.viceMayorText: The Vice Mayor presides over the Sangguniang Panlungsod and has succession and acting-mayor functions defined by law.
summary.councilText: The Sangguniang Panlungsod enacts local ordinances and approves annual and supplemental budgets and appropriations.
summary.departmentsText: City departments carry out specialized functions such as health, engineering, finance, social welfare, environment and public safety.
summary.noteAfterCharter: . For a transaction or concern, use Services or the government-office directory rather than starting with an elected-official profile.
